title: ssg worker module summary
description: The answer of a module's summary endpoint (endpoints.summary in module.json, GO-148): a few numbers, what needs a person's attention and what is wrong with the configuration, for an admin home page that renders every text as plain text. Contract 1. Aggregates only: no address, name, comment text, token, IP or any other per-person value. Readers ignore fields they do not know and refuse a summary whose contract is newer than theirs. Uses the same keyword subset as module.schema.json, and every pattern is valid both as an ECMAScript and as an RE2 (Go) expression.

contract.description: Version of this summary format; independent of the manifest contract.

generatedAt.description: When the module computed the answer, ISO 8601 in UTC.

metrics.description: At most four numbers worth a tile.

attention.description: Things that need a person, most serious first, each linking into the module's own panel.

problems.description: Configuration problems, never with a secret's value.

text.description: One text in the five panel languages; further language codes are allowed.

key.description: Stable camelCase name; two modules reading the same data use the same key for the same number.

severity.description: action: waits for a person's decision or work. warning: something is going wrong. info: good to know.

href.description: A path inside the module's own panel, relative to the module's base, like a manifest nav path (an optional #fragment for hash routing); never a URL.

code.description: Stable snake_case identifier of the problem.

series.description: One short daily series for a small chart.

points.description: Oldest first, one per UTC day.
